scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run validate
scripts.validate: npm run build --workspace=@nuedc/agent-cli && node packages/agent-cli/dist/runner.js validate
scripts.overview: npm run build --workspace=@nuedc/agent-cli && node packages/agent-cli/dist/runner.js overview
scripts.git:status: npm run build --workspace=@nuedc/git-core && npm run build --workspace=@nuedc/protocol && node scripts/git-safe.mjs status
scripts.git:pull: npm run build --workspace=@nuedc/git-core && npm run build --workspace=@nuedc/protocol && node scripts/git-safe.mjs pull
scripts.git:commit: npm run build --workspace=@nuedc/git-core && npm run build --workspace=@nuedc/protocol && node scripts/git-safe.mjs commit
scripts.git:push: npm run build --workspace=@nuedc/git-core && npm run build --workspace=@nuedc/protocol && node scripts/git-safe.mjs push
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build --workspace=@nuedc/git-core && npm run build --workspace=@nuedc/protocol && node tests/safe-git-cli-smoke.mjs
scripts.archive:frontend: node -e "console.log('前端基线仍保留在 归档/前端看板；活动实现位于 apps/dashboard')"
